correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed all 24 graph incidences and exhaustively enumerated actual matching simplices: 5096, 4199, 896 nonempty faces in full/deleted/link complexes, with f-vectors (24,216,912,1848,1632,464), (23,198,798,1540,1292,348), (18,114,308,340,116). Independently rebuilt complete greedy Morse pairings, checked acyclicity by topological sorting all 21504/17498/3092 nonempty-face incidences, computed signed integer gradient substitutions and extracted 14x53, 7x33, 3x16 Morse boundaries with full-row-rank determinant -1 minors for all three (private audit06_integral_morse_check.py). This yields integral cell cancellations and wedges, not only mod-two homology. Separate GF(2) simplicial boundary rank computation agreed. Cube axis permutations and coordinate flips act transitively on the 24 incidences; deleted-link map from wedge S^3 to 3-connected wedge S^4 is null, proving splitting for every edge.

originality.rationale: The matching complex equals independence complex of line graph L(R); generic claw-free results bound connectivity but do not classify this graph. Outerplanar wedge theorems do not apply: R has minimum degree 3, whereas outerplanar graphs have a vertex degree<=2. Manifold matching-complex classification does not apply because this simplicial complex is nonpure. Alias searches for the Miquel Levi and Fruchard graphs, and comparison to other polyhedral matching complexes in Resultary, did not reveal prior exact 39/26/13 all-edge homotopy splitting. Natural exact fixed-object structure survives without claiming a new general graph-family theorem.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact computation under configuration/graph alias or a new graph-categorical theorem may cover the wedge decomposition.
No equivariant or canonical homotopy type of the chosen splitting is proved; the result is ordinary homotopy only.

value.rationale: A named symmetric polyhedral incidence graph has a complete integral homotopy type and a uniform edge-deletion/link splitting not captured by field Betti ranks. The all-edge structural decomposition and explicit reproducible unimodular Morse certificates are motivated, not an arbitrary subgraph enumeration.

final_claim: The ordinary matching complex of the cube-corner/square-face incidence graph R of the rhombic dodecahedron is homotopy equivalent to 39 copies of S^4, while for every edge e={u,v}, the deletion complex is 26 copies of S^4, the link is 13 copies of S^3, and the natural deletion-link cofibration splits as M(R) ~= M(R-e) vee Sigma M(R-{u,v}).
limitations: One fixed 14-vertex, 24-edge graph, all of whose edges lie in a single automorphism orbit; no analogous general formula for polyhedral graphs.
Signed Morse certificate checks all finite faces and integral degrees; no equivariance or simplicial shellability claimed.
